convert_model_to_MOLE_model: convert a PyTorch model to use MOLE mixed expert linear layers with configurable expert count and SO2 replacement type
replace_linear_with_MOLE: replace an existing linear layer with a MOLE or MOLEDGL mixed expert layer using global tensors
recursive_replace_so2_linear: recursively replace all fc_m0 and SO2 convolution linear layers within SO2_Convolution modules using a replacement factory
recursive_replace_all_linear: recursively replace all torch.nn.Linear layers in a model with MOLE layers using a replacement factory
model_search_and_replace: search and replace modules in specific model blocks using a provided search function and replacement factory
